cd /private/tmp && mkdir -p test-eval && cd test-eval && cat > outputs.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "goodbye"]
EOF
cat > references.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "goodbye"]
EOF
cat outputs.json
mkdir -p /private/tmp/test-eval && cd /private/tmp/test-eval && echo '["hello", "world", "goodbye"]' > outputs.json && cat outputs.json

node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs /private/tmp/test-eval/outputs.json --references /private/tmp/test-eval/references.json --format markdown --threshold exact_match=0.8 --threshold length_variance=0.9 --report /tmp/report-multi.md; cat /tmp/report-multi.md

git add docs/eval_harness_design.md packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts packages/frai-core/README.md packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add --threshold option to frai eval for CI gating

- Add optional thresholds parameter to generateReport in frai-core
- Validate threshold format (metric=min) and values (0-1 range)
- Track pass/fail status for each threshold in reports
- Add thresholds section to markdown reports showing PASS/FAIL status
- CLI exits with 0 if all thresholds pass, 1 if any fail, 2 for invalid input
- Unknown metric IDs or malformed thresholds exit with code 2 and list valid metric IDs
- Metrics with null scores fail their thresholds instead of crashing
- Add comprehensive threshold tests to frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js
- Support multiple --threshold flags on CLI for multiple thresholds
- Update documentation in frai-core README and eval_harness_design.md

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

claude.result:
Excellent! The implementation is complete and working correctly. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

## Implementation Summary

I've successfully added the `--threshold` option to `frai eval` that allows CI pipelines to gate on evaluation metrics. Here's what was implemented:

### Core Changes (frai-core)

**1. `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`**
- Added `validateThresholds()` function to check threshold format and values (0-1 range)
- Added `evaluateThresholds()` function to check if metric scores meet minimums
- Updated `generateReport()` to accept optional `thresholds` parameter
- Reports now include `passed` (boolean) and `thresholds` (array) fields when thresholds are provided
- Metrics with null scores automatically fail their thresholds

**2. `packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`**
- Added "Thresholds" section to markdown reports showing `PASS`/`FAIL` status for each threshold
- Shows actual score vs. minimum requirement (e.g., "min: 0.9, actual: 0.5")

**3. `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`**
- Added 7 new tests covering:
  - Passing and failing thresholds
  - Null score handling (fails threshold)
  - Unknown metric rejection
  - Invalid threshold value rejection
  - Multiple thresholds
  - Mixed pass/fail thresholds

### CLI Changes (frai-cli)

**1. `packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`**
- Added `--threshold <metric=min>` option to eval command (supports multiple values)
- Added `parseThresholds()` helper to validate threshold format
- Updated `runEvalCommand()` to:
  - Parse threshold strings from CLI
  - Pass thresholds to `generateReport()`
  - Exit with code 1 if thresholds fail
  - Exit with code 2 if thresholds are invalid
  - List valid metric IDs in error messages

### Exit Codes
- **0**: All thresholds pass (or no thresholds specified)
- **1**: Any threshold fails
- **2**: Malformed threshold or unknown metric ID

### Documentation Updates
- Updated `packages/frai-core/README.md` with CLI option documentation and SDK example
- Updated `docs/eval_harness_design.md` to mention threshold support in extensibility section

### Test Results
✅ All 7 new threshold tests pass  
✅ No regressions (33 tests passing total, only pre-existing 2 failures remain)  
✅ Backward compatible (reports without thresholds work exactly as before)

The implementation is ready for commit. All files have been modified and tested successfully.
